engagement_type_shape.name: engagement_type_shape
engagement_type_shape.value:
("engagements"."type" = 'project' AND "engagements"."allowance_unit" = 'revisions'
           AND "engagements"."cycle_period" IS NULL AND "engagements"."allowance_included" = 0)
       OR ("engagements"."type" = 'retainer' AND "engagements"."allowance_unit" IN ('hours','tickets')
           AND "engagements"."cycle_period" IS NOT NULL AND "engagements"."allowance_included" > 0)
       OR ("engagements"."type" = 'subscription' AND "engagements"."allowance_unit" = 'days'
           AND "engagements"."cycle_period" IS NOT NULL
           AND "engagements"."grace_days" IS NOT NULL AND "engagements"."grace_days" >= 0)

item_cycle_link.name: item_cycle_link
item_cycle_link.value: "invoice_items"."source_kind" NOT IN ('retainer_overage','renewal') OR "invoice_items"."cycle_id" IS NOT NULL

invoice_issued_numbered.name: invoice_issued_numbered
invoice_issued_numbered.value: "invoices"."state" = 'draft' OR ("invoices"."number" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL)

lead_closed_dated.name: lead_closed_dated
lead_closed_dated.value: "leads"."stage" NOT IN ('won','lost') OR "leads"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL

lead_won_converted.name: lead_won_converted
lead_won_converted.value: "leads"."stage" <> 'won' OR ("leads"."client_id" IS NOT NULL AND "leads"."engagement_id" IS NOT NULL)

time_engagement_has_client.name: time_engagement_has_client
time_engagement_has_client.value: "time_entries"."engagement_id" IS NULL OR "time_entries"."client_id" IS NOT NULL
